node.title: L1 general polynomial-pullback interleaving descent
node.statement: For every monic degree-s polynomial P, each degree-below-k polynomial has a unique normal form f=sum_(j<s)X^j g_j(P), with exact residue-dependent caps k_j=ceil((k-j)/s). On every complete s-point P-fiber, Vandermonde inversion turns agreement with an arbitrary received word into common agreement of the quotient tuple (g_j) with an s-component receiver on the fiber label. For b complete labels the quotient evaluation kernel has exact dimension kappa=sum_j max(0,k_j-b), so the contributor count is at most q^kappa times the common-support interleaved list for degree-below-ceil(k/s) evaluation on those labels. The proved interleaving collapse reduces this to q^kappa floor(L(q-1)/(q-L)), and to q^kappa L when L^2<q. A full complete-fiber domain partition with k<n has kappa=0. Partial fibers, sparse coverage, and ordinary list bounds on generally non-smooth label domains remain open.
